Drop table dw.DimCustomerNameURL_IBG2_UT;

select 
    concat(dc.customername, ' - ',dc.customerid) as NameID,
    dc.customerid as CustomerID,
    case when dc.customertype in('Retail','RETAIL') then concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/178aa7b7-0378-41ea-927e-b71222d99acc/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''') 
            ELSE  concat('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/b9643d4b-a887-4d3e-9c51-9397af98029d/ReportSection74790b99f3cb412fcc52','?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''',dc.customerid,'''')
     END as URL
into dw.DimCustomerNameURL_IBG2_UT
from dw.dimcustomernametest dc
WHERE DC.CustomerID IN(Select Distinct CustomerID from DW.DimCustomer DC
    WHERE DC.CustomerSK IN(
        Select distinct CustomerSK from dw.DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList))
